_note: Shared title cases for supabase/functions/_shared/extract/title.ts (sanitizeTitle) and scripts/scrapers/outlist_crawler.py (sanitize_title / clean_title). Both implementations must return `expected`; an empty expected means the title is rejected (bad_title).
_waitlist_rule: 1. Match the whole words 'waitlist', 'wait list', 'wait-list' (separator: whitespace or a hyphen, optional) and 'wachtlijst', case-insensitive. Whole word means no letter or digit directly before or after (TS: (?<![\p{L}\p{N}])(?:wait[\s-]?list|wachtlijst)(?![\p{L}\p{N}]) with flags iu; Python: (?<!\w)(?:wait[\s-]?list|wachtlijst)(?!\w) with re.IGNORECASE).
2. Remove a bracket pair that contains only the word ( ) [ ] { } first, then the bare word, each replaced by a space.
4. Collapse a run of separators split only by whitespace into the first one: ([-–—|:·•,;/])(?:\s+[-–—|:·•,;/])+ -> \1
5. Collapse whitespace and trim, then let the existing edge-separator trim remove a leftover separator at either end.
6. Step 1-5 run inside the existing 4-pass sanitize loop, before the ticket call-to-action prefix/suffix strip.
